seo__search_description: Your referral to Oakdene House Foundation has been received. Someone from the team will be in touch within 2 business days.
content__text: Someone from the Oakdene team will be in touch within 2 business days. If the situation changes or becomes urgent, please call us on [(02) 8717 0999](tel:0287170999) during business hours. For 24-hour crisis support, visit our [Need Help Now](/need-help-now/) page.
